author: claude-fable-5-1
visual_review_findings: Compared the original (large heart cradled between an upper palm-down hand and a lower palm-up hand) with the rejected drawing (tiny holed heart between two bent strokes) at 48px in both themes. Redrew with a clear outlined heart at the centre and two cupped palm arcs with inward thumbs, rotationally opposed as in the original. Native review: heart reads at 48, arcs clear of the heart by 9+, thumbs at 45 degrees.
omissions: finger outlines and palm creases; the hands are reduced to a cupped palm arc plus thumb
construction_reference: Lucide heart (lobe + shoulder + straight sides); hand reduction follows the set's hand-holding-heart
